group.name: Paramilitary (CAPF & Assam Rifles) Direct Recruitments
group.intro: Ye specialist posts hain jin par har force khud bharti karti hai; general-duty posts SSC GD, SSC CPO aur UPSC CAPF AC se aati hain. Har specialist post ka apna notice hota hai, aur ek post ki jagah doosri post nahi li ja sakti. Neeche di gayi details haal ke notices jaisi hain. Fee usually UR/OBC/EWS men ke liye ₹100 hai, aur women, SC, ST aur ex-servicemen ke liye koi fee nahi. Zyadatar posts mein interview nahi hota; Medical Officer posts interview se bhari jaati hain. Constable-level ka common PST: men 170 cm, women 157 cm (UR); ST 162.5 / 150 cm; men ka chest 80 + 5 cm. CAPF constable posts ke liye MHA ne ex-Agniveers ko reservation aur PET mein chhoot dene ki ghoshna ki hai; exact conditions ke liye har notice check karein.
group.ageRelaxation.rows.7.rule: CAPF aur Railway: pehle batch ke liye 5 saal tak, uske baad 3 saal
group.ageRelaxation.notes.0: Final-year students aam taur par graduate exams mein apply kar sakte hain, agar notice ki cut-off date tak unke paas degree hogi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.1: CAPF direct recruitment mein central chhoot lagti hai: OBC +3, SC / ST +5. Ex-servicemen: age minus service + 3 saal. Ex-Agniveers: har notice mein MHA rules ke hisaab se.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.2: PwBD candidates combat aur uniformed CAPF posts ke liye eligible nahi hain.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.3: NSG aur SPG sirf deputation par personnel lete hain, isliye direct age ya qualification ka koi rule nahi hai.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.4: Usi force ke departmental candidates ko aam taur par extra chhoot milti hai; notice check karein.
